excluded_receivers.reason: Creates Lead state and audit record; not required to authenticate receipt and must not be invoked merely because an inbound email exists.
Creates stage=scoping and probability=50; would synthesize commercial state before bounded request normalization.

required_evidence: provider-observed inbound message in the authenticated mailbox addressed to the published contact
offer identity from the offer-specific subject/link or unambiguous message content
message content sufficient to establish an engagement request rather than spam/automated traffic
fail_closed_when: message cannot be tied to an ICV offering or engagement request
only a user assertion/screenshot/copied text exists without the applicable authenticated provider observation when provider observation is required

required_evidence: private provider evidence reference, not public message body
customer/organization name as supplied or authentically attributable
delivery/timing/privacy/acceptance/dependency fields recorded as supplied or UNKNOWN
fail_closed_when: private message body or provider identifiers would be published
sender identity is promoted to authorized decision maker without evidence

required_evidence: source authority and unreleased/unproven substrate boundary
proposal envelope conforms to commercial/scoped-engagement-proposal.schema.json and references the applicable offering package
fail_closed_when: scope/price/authority is inferred beyond offering package

required_evidence: authentic acceptance attributable to authorized customer counterpart
exact accepted proposal/SOW identity and version
transitions.reason: No universal authenticated contract-acceptance owner/path is presently established across all twelve offerings.

required_evidence: separately authorized payment mechanism or authentic payment evidence
transitions.reason: NO_PAYMENT_EXECUTION_PATH remains explicit; test-only StegPay evidence is not production payment authority.

must_remain_private: message body unless separately authorized for publication
personal contact details beyond already-public business contact

crm_boundary: CRM projection or Lead/Deal creation is a later separately admitted action. Authentic inbound request evidence does not itself authorize or require a Lead, Deal, probability, qualification, write-back or source-stage mutation.
